description: Get the current AIHOT Top 10 with each event's one-based rank. Use this for 'what is hot now' and to discover valid story public IDs; use aihot_get_latest for a chronological news list. Internal heat scores are not returned.

lang.description: Answer language: en gives the titles, summaries and digests in English where translated (the few not yet stay in Chinese), links to the English pages and English wording; zh (the default) answers in Chinese.

limit.description: Maximum number of current topics, from 1 to 10.

name: aihot_get_hot_topics
